meta.name: validating-api-schemas
meta.description:
Validate API schemas against OpenAPI, JSON Schema, and GraphQL specifications.
Use when validating API schemas and contracts.
Trigger with phrases like "validate API schema", "check OpenAPI spec", or "verify schema".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 校验API接口规范，提前发现契约错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常编写或校验OpenAPI等接口规范
copy.tagline_en: Validate API schemas to catch contract issues early
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly write or validate OpenAPI specs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 OpenAPI、JSON Schema、GraphQL 标准检查接口定义文件,找出漏文档的接口、断裂的引用、命名不一致等问题,并生成带严重级别的报告。
howto.when: 当你提出校验 API 模式或接口契约,或说出「validate API schema」「check OpenAPI spec」「verify schema」等触发词时,该技能会被激活。

say.text: 校验项目里的 OpenAPI 规格,列出所有问题。
say.note: 会执行结构校验并输出报告。

say.text: 检查 API 模式相对上一版本有没有破坏性变更。
say.note: 会对比旧版并生成变更分析。

say.text: 运行模式完整性检查,找出缺文档的端点。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will validate API specification files against OpenAPI, JSON Schema, and GraphQL standards, detecting missing documentation, broken references, naming inconsistencies, and more, and generate reports with severity levels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to validate API schemas or contracts, or uses phrases like 'validate API schema', 'check OpenAPI spec', or 'verify schema'.

say_en.text: Validate the project's OpenAPI spec and list all issues.
say_en.note: Runs validation and outputs a report.

say_en.text: Check the API schema for breaking changes against the previous version.
say_en.note: Compares schemas and generates a breaking-change report.

say_en.text: Run a schema completeness check to find endpoints missing documentation.
